row_tolerances: 1e-12 for state/command/reference fields; 1e-11 for physical jerk, command derivative and reference snap. Comparison tolerance, not an integration error bound.
metrics_tolerance: Every independently recomputed physical metric differs by less than1e-10; figures/ranges/ratios by less than1e-9.
reuse: Prior critic03 already-replayed baseline rows are reused with their complete frozen evidence; all90 new physical traces are replayed afresh.
